style.backgroundSystem: warm near-white #FDFDFA for packshot and macro, misty periwinkle blue #ACB7D0 for benefit and closing panels, pale grey-blue #D6DDE8 for scene and spec screens

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh airy kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm near-white #FDFDFA, misty periwinkle blue #ACB7D0, pale grey-blue #D6DDE8 and slate text #4B5159; bright soft daylight studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle skimming light for texture and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style in slate; clean bright childrenswear photography mixed with airy infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, garment always fully spread or neatly presented, consistent scale
